resources.string: The app did not close properly last time. You can email a report to the developer to help fix the problem: it contains records of the app session and basic device information, and no personal data. You can review the email before sending it.
The report was handed over to your email app. Review the email there, then send it.
Attach this file to the email which was just opened, then send it. The file will be deleted when you close this message!
No email app could be opened. Email this file to %1$s: the address was copied to the clipboard. The file will be deleted when you close this message!
